name: Most Dangerous Game
description: Desperate to take care of his pregnant wife before a terminal illness can take his life, Dodge Maynard accepts an offer to participate in a deadly game where he soon discovers that he’s not the hunter but the prey.

videos.title: The Offer
videos.overview: Struggling and desperate, Dodge accepts an offer to get back on his feet financially. But it comes with a price.

videos.title: The Motivation
videos.overview: Debt and a baby on the way make for desperate times. Dodge grows increasingly concerned about the future of his family.

videos.title: The Rules
videos.overview: A trip to the hospital reveals a life-changing diagnosis. With nowhere to turn, Dodge is tempted to make a deadly decision.

videos.title: The Acceptance
videos.overview: The rules are set. The prize is tempting. And the situation is dire. All Dodge has to do is accept...and the game begins.

videos.title: The Start
videos.overview: The game is on. Paranoia, panic, and fear settle in for Dodge as the hunters could be anywhere. Or anyone.

videos.title: Wash Hands After Using
videos.overview: Crowds are your friend. Dodge ducks into a bustling business center to stay in public-sight and out of danger.

videos.title: No Running on the Platform
videos.overview: Dodge’s location is revealed to the hunters. Can he escape before it’s too late?

videos.title: Please Whisper in Church
videos.overview: Dodge tries to find sanctuary in a new location. Meanwhile, Valerie questions the source of newfound money in her bank account.

videos.title: Return Tools to Their Place
videos.overview: Not all games are fair. Dodge learns a painful lesson when it’s revealed that the hunters have a secret advantage.

videos.title: Five for Fighting
videos.overview: The stakes get higher the longer Dodge survives. He tries to blend in at a hockey game while Valerie digs deeper into the bank deposits.

videos.title: You Always Remember Your First
videos.overview: A bad move brings Dodge to the brink of the Detroit boundary. He’s determined to bring the fight back to the city, but the hunters are right on his heels.

videos.title: A Ship is Safe Only in Port
videos.overview: Hard times can bring out the worst in us all. Dodge continues to fight for his life in the face of what he’s become. But how long can he keep it up?

videos.title: Always Get a Second Opinion
videos.overview: The game gets complicated when Dodge encounters a gang in the projects. And if they don’t believe his story, there may be even more bloodshed.

videos.title: What's Old Is New Again
videos.overview: Dodge uncovers a truth that reveals the game isn’t what it seems. And nobody is to be trusted. Not even those closest to him.

videos.title: Game Over
videos.overview: It’s the final showdown. With the game spiraling out of control, Dodge gives everything he has to bring it all to an end.

videos.title: Auction
videos.overview: The numerous complications of a previous game make the stakes higher than ever for Miles to deliver an exceptional hunt to the Tiro Fund and their clients. He searches for the perfect prey to whet the appetites of clients.

videos.title: Play Ball
videos.overview: Having sworn to protect his sister after the death of their parents, Victor makes a last-ditch effort to get out from under the mob debt, but fails. Between Miles' offer and the mobster's threats, Victor is stuck between two life-or-death situations.

videos.title: Devil in the Outfield
videos.overview: The game is on, Victor is in the midst of millions of New Yorkers, and any of them could be hunters; it could be a passenger on the subway or the hot dog vendor on the corner. Victor won't know for sure until they go in for the kill.

videos.title: On the Wrong Track
videos.overview: Victor's rash actions come back to haunt him, and now he must avoid the NYPD along with the hunters looking to kill him. The rules of the hunt are beautifully simple, yet brutally strict, get arrested during the hunt, and the hunt never ends.

videos.title: En Fuego
videos.overview: Miles is in the hot seat when the Tiro Fund Board gets word of Victor's impending arrest. Meanwhile, Victor is in an even hotter seat across town, after the first hour of the game ends and the hunters are all given his exact location.

videos.title: Katie Girl
videos.overview: Cornered and desperate, Victor is forced to relive his childhood trauma if he has any hope of surviving the hunt. Meanwhile, Josie and Mr. Dupree's attempts to help are inadvertently putting Victor in even more danger.

videos.title: Busted
videos.overview: Victor ditches the protection of crowds for isolation at the city's fringes. Trouble is, he's not alone for long. As the cops and hunters encircle him, Victor is on the verge of becoming a permanent player in the game.

videos.title: A Good Lawyer's Hard To Find
videos.overview: Following Victor's arrest, both he and Miles are on the edge of a razor. The integrity of the hunt is spiraling out of control, and Miles presents Victor a game-changing offer with the help of a new player to uphold the spirit of the game.

videos.title: Company at the Water Company
videos.overview: Victor is in the most intense fight for his life yet with new games and old faces, but the surprises keep on coming as the hunt takes a shocking turn, and Victor learns the truth about his chance meeting with Miles and the Tiro Fund.

videos.title: One Way Ticket
videos.overview: With his injuries increasing, Victor's hometown knowledge of New York becomes his best defense, and his only chance for survival. Josie gets the jump on Victor's location and rushes to find him, unknowingly placing herself at risk as in the process.

videos.title: Lighthouse
videos.overview: As the hunt careens to a close, Victor just might win the game, but with Josie's unexpected arrival, he just might lose everything he loves. Meanwhile, Miles fears his off-book plays have put him squarely in the crosshairs of the Tiro Fund Board.

videos.title: Blood Work
videos.overview: As the hunters close in on Victor and Josie, their chances of leaving the game alive dwindle with each passing moment. Miles feels the pressure as well when the Chairwoman of the Tiro Fund Board forces him to make an impossible choice.

awards: Nominated for 2 Primetime Emmys. 5 nominations total
